notes.title: Ultimate Arena update is officially cancelled
notes.content:
It is with a heavy heart that I have to officially announce the Ultimate Arena big update cancelled.

I regret to inform you that due to a lack of commitment from two of the developers it is no longer possible to continue developing content for the game.

A very difficult decision was made by me to completely halt development, since the key people who were supposed to be working on the project aren't able to do so anymore.

The process of working on the big update was rocky and inconsistent and I was looking at a drawn out process which in the best case scenario would have ended with a bare-bones build consisting of only one level.

Simply put, there was a lot of work to be done and precious little time to be spared.

On a personal note, I am extremely disappointed in this turn of events and did everything in my power to keep the project alive despite the drawbacks.

Sadly it wasn't meant to be, and I don't have the means to work on the project alone.

I would like to offer my most sincere apologies to everyone who, like me, was waiting for the update to arrive.

The current version of Ultimate Arena will remain of Steam and can still be played via "Host Game", so nothing has changed in that regard.

Project lead
Kenneth 'Zeb89' Caselli

notes.title: What's coming to Ultimate Arena
notes.content:
Hello ultimarines,

While we may have been somewhat quiet during the past months, we've been tirelessly working under the hood to bring you the largest update to [b]Ultimate Arena[/b] yet. Here is a list of some of the things you can expect:

[list]
[*] Graphical rework of game levels (initially only Hall will be included)
[*] New character animations
[*] New character models
[*] Reworked weapon models and textures
[*] User Interface overhaul
[*] Reworked particle effects
[*] New HUD
[*] New lobby system
[*] Additional sound effects
[/list]
... and more.

Since we are few and we are working on the game in our free time, it's impossible to say how long it will take to complete, and it would be dishonest to give you an estimate right now. All of this work takes plenty of time and effort to finalise and that is why, as mentioned above, only a rework of Hall will be included with the first update, with more levels to come later on.

Working on something like this is a huge undertaking for a small team like ours, thus we hope that you will enjoy what we have in store for you.  



[i]Here are some screenshots of the upper part of Hall. All of it is still work in progress and subject to change. [/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12176944/4be12818314fea1464c903ac6e4bd52aa6b59019.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12176944/8a706a45c233157f19be59f5a14ed4efd6a58525.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12176944/9cfe0a6df6e7df19adbdea88d8c62d3c7f7bf656.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12176944/db01618a6e28b15cc104bd568411da7fe78b8e57.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12176944/f420ccc1df48de47041c557bb153bb0f9bf5fb17.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12176944/b27535c536a06f6fd7816d23022fc9ad1879ab6c.jpg[/img]


We're eager to read your thoughts in the discussion page, and on our [url=http://discord.gg/ultimatearenafps]Discord[/url] server.  We're always open to suggestions, so do not hesitate to share your feedback.

If you do not yet own the game, this is a great time to add it to your Steam wishlist and keep an eye on it.
Until next time!

Ultimate Arena is receiving an update!
We have just launched our first PTB in order to find and fix potential issues before releasing the patch.

If you'd like to try out this build, just select "public test" from the drop down menu in the Ultimate Arena game properties on Steam.

After having done this, launch the game and select "Play debug version".

You can host a session from the "Host Game" menu and other players using the PTB will be able to join.

We'll be running a few dedicated servers of our own shortly after releasing 1.8.

Here's the changelog so far:

- Updated game engine.
- Added new map: TDM - Factory.
- Added underwater combat.
- Added performance awards (Multi-kills, Accuracy and Perfects).
- Added color picker in the settings for Ultimarine characters.
- Added playable warmup mode. You can now explore maps before other players join the session.
- Added player taunt action (default is "U" key).
- Added notification for players who join/leave the current session.
- Added third person animation for Gas Rifle secondary fire.
- Added max spectators setting to "Host Game" menu.
- Added working "Join as spectator" checkbox in "Join Game" menu.
- Added tooltips while hovering over scoreboard icons.
- Armor now absorbs damage, protecting health.
- Slightly increased player acceleration.
- Fixed an issue which caused player positions to desync when connecting to a match in progress.
- Fixed FPS counter resetting when opening the scoreboard.
- Fixed Plasma Cannon projectile collision issue which caused plasma balls to collide as soon as fired.
- Fixed Gas Rifle primary fire sometimes causing harm to player when not intended.
- Fixed spectator not being able to move as Host on personal sessions.
- Fixed specator mode sometimes causing game to crash.
- Adjusted post processing to reduce excessive light glare effects.
- Changed Ultimate Damage powerup effect on player weapons.
- Minor changes and improvements to UI, particles and gameplay.
